content.title: What is Squid about?
content.description: Squid is the cross-chain infrastructure layer that powers the movement of digital value across more than 100 blockchains and 20,000+ tokens. Instead of asking users to manage individual bridges, gas tokens and signatures, Squid collapses that complexity into a single intent — "send X, receive Y on chain Z" — routed across the full multichain surface and settled in one action. The product stack spans Squid Intents (the protocol layer, sub-5-second execution), the Squid Aggregator (routing across 130+ DEXs and off-chain liquidity sources), Squid Token Service and Accounts for abstraction, the Squid SDK for developers, and the live Squid Bridge. Coverage reaches 106+ chains across EVM, Cosmos, Bitcoin, Solana, XRPL and Hedera. QUID is the native token of the ecosystem, used for staking, priority product access and governance.

content.title: About Ergo
content.description: Ergo is a flexible blockchain protocol designed for developing decentralized applications, focusing on efficient, secure, and easy implementation of financial contracts. It incorporates various technical and economic improvements to existing blockchain solutions. Each coin in Ergo is protected by a program in ErgoScript, a powerful and protocol-friendly scripting language based on Σ-protocols. ErgoScript enables users to encode conditions for coin usage, including who can spend them, when, under what external conditions, and to whom. The protocol supports light nodes, making it user-friendly by allowing contract execution on untrusted commodity hardware. Ergo prioritizes long-term usability through a survivability approach, utilizing widely-researched solutions that prevent security issues and performance degradation over time, with a new economic model. Additionally, Ergo features a self-amendable protocol, allowing it to absorb new ideas and improve itself in the future.

content.title: What is Hyperliquid about?
content.description: Hyperliquid is a layer one (L1) blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Beyond its flagship DEX trading platform, the ecosystem supports borrowing, lending, real world assets (RWAs), and a full-fledged Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), making it a leading force in decentralized finance (defi).

content.title: What is pump.fun?
content.description: Pump.fun is a Solana-based memecoin generator/launchpad that simplifies the process of creating tokens, allowing users to launch their own memecoins without needing technical expertise.

content.title: About HOME (HOME)
content.description: HOME is an integrated decentralized finance platform designed to simplify on-chain trading and earning through a unified interface across multiple blockchain networks.

content.title: What is NEAR Protocol?
content.description: NEAR Protocol is the blockchain for AI. A high-performance, AI-native platform built to power the next generation of decentralized applications and intelligent agents. It provides the infrastructure AI needs to transact, operate, and interact across Web2 and Web3. NEAR combines three core elements: User-Owned AI, which ensures agents act in users’ best interests; Intents and Chain Abstraction, which eliminate blockchain complexity for seamless, goal-driven transactions across chains; and a sharded blockchain architecture that delivers the scalability, speed, and low-cost execution needed for real-world AI and Web3 use. This integrated stack makes NEAR the foundation for building secure, user-owned, AI-native applications at internet scale.

content.title: About Solana (SOL)
content.description: Solana is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain built for mass adoption, offering a fast and low-cost environment for decentralized applications.

content.title: What is UNI?
content.description: UNI is the governance token for Uniswap. UNI was introduced on 16th September 2020 through a retrospective airdrop to users who have interacted with the protocol either by swapping tokens or by providing liquidity.

content.title: What is Aave?
content.description: Aave is a decentralized money market protocol where users can lend and borrow cryptocurrency across 20 different assets as collateral.

content.title: About Ethereum
content.description: Ethereum is a blockchain platform that enables developers to build and deploy smart contracts and decentralized applications, operating through thousands of independent nodes worldwide rather than through a central authority.

content.title: About Sui (SUI)
content.description: Sui is a Layer 1 blockchain designed for global adoption by providing a high-speed and secure environment for digital asset ownership.

content.title: What is TON?
content.description: TON (The Open Network) is a Layer 1 smart contract network specializing in financial applications. It was first developed by Telegram’s co-founder Nikolai Durov known as “Telegram Open Network” but has been relaunched as “The Open Network” under the TON Foundation.

content.title: What is Ethena?
content.description: Ethena is a synthetic dollar protocol built on Ethereum that provides a crypto-native solution for money that is not reliant on traditional banking system infrastructure. Its synthetic dollar USDe is known as the 'Internet Bond' and offers a dollar-denominated savings instrument with the benefits of DeFi.
